title: Hera Syndulla
description: Making the transition from Rebel leader to General in the New Republic, Hera Syndulla never lost her skill as a gifted pilot or her nurturing, maternal nature. As a steadfast leader with a caring heart, she was instrumental in leading the rebellion on Lothal and aiding in the post-imperial reconstruction. Her young son, Jacen, accompanied her on missions where his insight with the Force was an asset.
